title: Ian C.:
title_short: Ian C. · The timer is scary
headline: Ian heard about it from his friends. The timer is scary, everything else is fun, and math stopped being boring.
story: Ian found Math Hoops through word of mouth. He is not a big sports fan, but the game gives “laughter” and time with other people.
His honest hook: the timer is scary, because if you run out you do not get the point. Everything else is fun. Math was boring; now he says it is really fun.
Loops: L1 “Why is the timer scary?” opens at 0:00 and closes at 0:06. L2 “Did it change math?” opens at 0:14 and closes at 0:24. Stakes: math problems with no fun in them.
do: Open on “The timer's like really scary” with the hook text already on screen.
Cut to kids laughing on “It gives like laughter”.
Put <q>Are you happy?</q> on screen before his last answer.
End on “play some games after school”, then the Donate end card.
dont: Do not use his intro (full name and school).
Do not use the school name the student says at the start.
No logo, name or fade at 0:00.
No end-of-year campaign words on the end card.

visual.json (shoot level). Its B-roll descriptions are rough; the picks in this plan were checked on real frames.
Font RangleRiforma Bold. LearnFresh primary logo + NBA Math Hoops co-brand logo. Both in the brand kit in Airtable. Style guide colours are not loaded on this page yet.
tech: Interview camera, 1920×1080 at 59.94 fps (from visual.json), one file per subject. Audio recorded into the camera.
Interview mic into the camera. The gym was loud: kids are audible behind every answer. Keep a little room tone, it sells the day. Level pass and light noise reduction only.
Master: 1920×1080, 16:9. Version two: 1080×1920, 9:16. Same edit, same order. Source is 59.94 fps: use a 29.97 fps timeline and interpret footage, no speed change.
Interviews are medium shots with the subject in the center: center crop. B-roll is 16:9: crop on the hands and faces (cx numbers in this plan are from small frames, check by eye).
-14 LUFS integrated, -1 dBTP peak. Music always under the voice.
Pauses inside a bite longer than 0.7 s are cut to about 0.25 s. Row times in this plan count that.
Burned in, low in the frame, client font RangleRiforma Bold (brand kit in Airtable). Spell NBA Math Hoops (the auto-transcript writes “MBA”), Learn Fresh, WestEd.
Two H.264 MP4s: 16:9 1920×1080 and 9:16 1080×1920. Upload to Frame.io, then Ready for Review.
checklist: Frame 1 is the speaker with the hook text already on screen. No logo, no name, no fade at 0:00.
The hook text does not animate on.
The name super comes in at 00:03 or later, lower left, 2 s.
Captions spell NBA Math Hoops, never MBA.
No school names anywhere on screen.
The end card carries the call to action in this plan and nothing about the end-of-year campaign.
Two exports: 16:9 master and 9:16, same edit.
Student super is first name + last initial + grade only. Never a last name.
client_note: Why this matters: he found the program through friends. Word of mouth is how Learn Fresh hopes kids join.
